## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; confirmation: Materials/Financials/Industrials are leading while Tech is mixed, and Top-5 leadership is broad — supports sector rotation away from concentrated Growth. Major divergence across large caps (several mega-caps in CORRECTION) warrants tactical caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +28.27%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: SCHW (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +12.07%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials supporting the move: BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: D (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft with notable outliers: NKE (1W: -15.58% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +25.92%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +7.28% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY; FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND; SCHW (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +12.07%) ABOVE TREND; BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: MMM (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -2.80%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +5.34%) CORRECTION; DE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -1.59%) BELOW TREND; PSA (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND; AMT (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Real Estate.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: EL (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +25.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +7.28% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note divergence: ORCL’s 1W jump vs 1M decline signals a tactical reversal, not yet broad accumulation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed with pockets of strength and short-term pullbacks: MSFT (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.15% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION — rotation into cyclicals is capping a broad Tech thrust.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are firm: JPM (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +8.28%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +12.07%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth driving the rotation and supporting Value/Cyclical style.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed and headline-driven: MRK (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +11.21%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, but JNJ (1W: -3.20% | 1M: +2.74%) CORRECTION and UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION reflect sentiment-driven divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Materials exposure and select Industrials given above-trend leadership (SCHW, C, FCX, BA); reduce exposure to names showing CORRECTION (AAPL, WMT, UNH) and to concentrated Growth exposure until trend confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical — but major-cap divergences imply tactical sizing and monitoring for trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +12.07%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.58% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials, Financials, Industrials (rotation leaders; breadth support). BEARISH: Real Estate, Utilities, Consumer Discretionary (lagging and headline-sensitive, watch for further outflows).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND — weekly close above this week’s high would validate continuation. AAPL (1W: -1.15% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION — hold of the monthly base needed to negate deeper pullback. BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND — sustainment above recent breakout moves confirms industrial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+50): GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND — positive AI coverage confirming price strength. AMT (+55): AMT (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price declining (divergence). JNJ (+75): JNJ (1W: -3.20% | 1M: +2.74%) CORRECTION — bullish FDA nod cited but price is slipping (mixed signals).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (-50): LLY (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headline on competitive FDA approval but price still rising (divergence). TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +23.66%) ABOVE TREND — negative sales headline diverges from strong momentum. D (-45): D (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirm price weakness. UNH (-40): UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION — negative debt story aligns with near-term weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION; Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth. FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +12.07%) ABOVE TREND and BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (AAPL, JNJ, UNH in CORRECTION) and mixed sentiment headlines (JNJ, AMT, LLY) require tactical sizing and close monitoring for trend confirmation.
